title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: When considering loss functions, think about how they handle differences between predicted and actual values. A higher power in the loss function can amplify these differences, especially for larger errors.

title: Comparing Powers in Loss Functions
text: Consider how the power of the difference term affects the sensitivity of the loss function to outliers. Higher powers will increase the penalty for larger errors more than lower powers.

hintAnswer: It increases the penalty for larger errors compared to MSE.
title: Analyzing the Power of $$3$$
text: What happens to the penalty for errors when you use a power of $$3$$ in the loss function?
choices: It increases the penalty for larger errors compared to MSE.
It decreases the penalty for larger errors compared to MSE.
It has no effect on the penalty for larger errors.

hintAnswer: It makes the loss function more sensitive to outliers than MSE.
title: Absolute Value and Powers
text: How does using an absolute value with a power of $$5$$ affect the loss function's sensitivity to outliers?
choices: It makes the loss function more sensitive to outliers than MSE.
It makes the loss function less sensitive to outliers than MSE.
It has no effect on the sensitivity to outliers.
